key_idea: After 4 quarter turns the card looks just like it did at the start, so the pictures repeat.
steps: The dot goes from the right side (turn 1) to the bottom (turn 2) to the left side (turn 3). Next it goes to the top (turn 4).
After 4 turns the card is back where it started. After 8 turns it is back again.
Turns 9 and 10 are just like turns 1 and 2. So after turn 10 the dot is at the bottom, like after turn 2.

choice_feedback.A: The dot is at the top after turns 4 and 8. After turn 10 it is 2 more turns along.
choice_feedback.B: The dot is on the right after turn 1 and turn 9. After turn 10 it has moved on.
choice_feedback.C: The dot is on the left after turn 3 and turn 11, not turn 10.
choice_feedback.E: The dot never goes into a corner. It moves from the middle of one side to the next.
